caption: Left ventricular blood pressure over one beat in the normal case (thick black "Normal"; the thin black femoral-stenosis curve lies on it). Digitised every 0.01 s into liang2009_fig4a_lv_pressure.csv (axes calibrated from the tick marks at 0/0.5/1.0 s and 0-200 mmHg): peak 108.1 mmHg at 0.21 s, minimum 1.6 mmHg at 0.45 s, about 7 mmHg at the start and end of the beat.

Ascending-aortic blood pressure over one beat, normal case (thick black). Digitised every 0.01 s into liang2009_fig4b_aortic_pressure.csv (axes from the tick marks: 0/0.5/1.0 s, 60-120 mmHg; the legend and the panel label, above 100 mmHg, left out): 79.1 mmHg just before ejection (0.10 s), peak 105.5 mmHg at 0.23 s, 81.4 mmHg at 1 s. The data the validation loop's afterload is calibrated to (lv_obs_data.json).

Left ventricular pressure-volume loop, normal case (thick black). Its vertical edges, digitised: end-systolic volume 41.8 ml (left) and end-diastolic volume 117.6 ml (right); stroke volume 75.8 ml. The end-diastolic volume is the lv parameterisation's q_init (the runs start at early systole).
